# A popover opens at its target, placed by CSS anchor positioning

Parent: #21367 (Dialogs & Overlays: the popover's defect is fixed before its card is renewed). Promotes defect-note `0bd1ec00`.

## Context

In `examples/popover`, a click on "Click Me" opens the popover clipped into the window's top-left corner, not at the button (defect-note `0bd1ec00`). Re-measured on `dev` `267eb2336f` at 1024 × 768 in Chromium: the button spans x 217–417, y 407–431; the open popover spans x −135–135, y 8–72, so half of it is off the left edge. The popover element carries `anchor="neo-button-1"`. The browser reports `position-anchor`, `position-area` and `position-try-fallbacks` as supported (`CSS.supports`), and `'anchorElement' in HTMLElement.prototype` as `false`.

Live latest-open + closed sweep: checked the latest 20 open plus open and closed search ("popover") at 2026-11-19T02:35Z and again at 02:47Z; the one closed hit, #19933, fixed a load error and leaves placement alone. 75 open, red band: folds under #21367.
A2A in-flight sweep: latest 12 messages in all read-states at 02:35Z and 6 at 02:47Z; no claim on the popover.
MC sweep: "popover opens in the top-left corner instead of aligned to its target", 5 results, none about this plugin.
Own-assignment sweep: 8 open, none overlapping (#21415 is the dialog leaf).

## The Problem

`Neo.plugin.Popover` was written against the 2023 draft of CSS anchor positioning:

- it ties the popover to its target with the HTML `anchor` attribute (`src/plugin/Popover.mjs`, `vdom: {anchor: owner.id}`), which no shipping browser implements;
- its placements are `@position-fallback` rules with `anchor()` insets, an at-rule the specification renamed to `@position-try` before any browser shipped it;
- those rules live in `resources/css/src/examples/popover/MainContainer.css`, so the engine's plugin has no placement of its own, and no theme gives the popover colours.

With no anchor, the UA's `[popover]` style and the example's `inset: unset` leave the popover at the top-left of the viewport.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: "Defaults to bottom center of popover is aligned to top center of owner" — `Neo.plugin.Popover#align` (`src/plugin/Popover.mjs:53`), whose valid values are `alignValues` (`bc-tc`, `tc-bc`, `tl-tr`, `tr-tl`, `cl-cr`, `cr-cl`).

- The plugin adds a `Neo.container.Base` with `vdom.popover: 'auto'` next to its owner, and stamps `popovertarget` on the owner (the native invoker toggles it on click); `Neo.main.addon.Popover` shows and hides it on hover.
- Vdom `style` keys reach the DOM through `style.setProperty(Neo.decamel(key))` (`src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:945`), so `anchorName` and `positionAnchor` arrive as `anchor-name` and `position-anchor`.
- Plugin styles live in `resources/css/src/plugin/` (`Resizable.css`, `PrefixField.css`).

## The Fix

1. `Neo.plugin.Popover`: the owner gets `style.anchorName: '--<popoverId>'`, the popover `style.positionAnchor` with the same name; the `anchor` attribute goes.
2. `resources/css/src/plugin/Popover.css`: one rule per `align` value with `position-area` (`bc-tc` → `top`, `tc-bc` → `bottom`, `tl-tr` → `right span-bottom`, `tr-tl` → `left span-bottom`, `cl-cr` → `right`, `cr-cl` → `left`) and `position-try-fallbacks` (`flip-block` above and below, `flip-inline` beside), plus the margin, radius and shadow; colours from theme tokens in every theme.
3. `examples/popover`: its stylesheet keeps only what the example itself needs; the stage title stops reading `Neo.container.Base`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In `examples/popover`, "Click Me" opens the popover centred above the button, and each `align` value places it on its side of the target. An e2e spec measures the popover's rect against the button's.
- [ ] Near a viewport edge the popover flips to the other side instead of leaving the screen. Same spec.
- [ ] The popover reads in every theme. Before/after frames in the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Browsers without CSS anchor positioning: they show the popover where the UA puts it, as today.
- The popover card's cover and the Dialogs & Overlays renewal (#21367's renewal leaf).
- The dialog's mask and focus (#21415).

## Avoided Traps

- Aligning in JS with `Neo.main.DomAccess#align`: the plugin is built on the native popover, and the browser already places it against a named anchor without a round trip per scroll.
- Porting `@position-fallback` to `@position-try` one to one: `position-area` and the `flip-*` keywords say the same in a line each.
